verses.original: וְאַתָּ֤ה בֶן־ אָדָם֙ הִנָּבֵ֣א עַל־ גּ֔וֹג וְאָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ כֹּ֥ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה אָמַ֖ר הִנְנִ֤י אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ גּ֔וֹג רֹ֖אשׁ נְשִׂ֕יא מֶ֥שֶׁךְ וְתֻבָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ḇen- ’ā·ḏām hin·nā·ḇê ‘al- gō·wḡ wə·’ā·mar·tā kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar hin·nî ’ê·le·ḵā gō·wḡ rōš nə·śî me·šeḵ wə·ṯu·ḇāl
verses.literal: As for you O son of man prophesy against Gog and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says Behold I am against you O Gog chief prince of Meshech and Tubal

verses.original: וְשֹׁבַבְתִּ֙יךָ֙ וְשִׁשֵּׁאתִ֔יךָ וְהַעֲלִיתִ֖יךָ מִיַּרְכְּתֵ֣י צָפ֑וֹן וַהֲבִאוֹתִ֖ךָ עַל־ הָרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šō·ḇaḇ·tî·ḵā wə·šiš·šê·ṯî·ḵā wə·ha·‘ă·lî·ṯî·ḵā mî·yar·kə·ṯê ṣā·p̄ō·wn wa·hă·ḇi·’ō·w·ṯi·ḵā ‘al- hā·rê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: I will turn you around drive you along bring you up from the far north and send you against the mountains of Israel

verses.original: וְהִכֵּיתִ֥י קַשְׁתְּךָ֖ שְׂמֹאולֶ֑ךָ מִיַּ֣ד אַפִּֽיל׃ וְחִצֶּ֕יךָ יְמִינְךָ֖ מִיַּ֥ד
verses.transliteration: wə·hik·kê·ṯî qaš·tə·ḵā śə·mō·w·le·ḵā mî·yaḏ ’ap·pîl wə·ḥiṣ·ṣe·ḵā yə·mî·nə·ḵā mî·yaḏ
verses.literal: Then I will strike the bow from your left hand and dash down the arrows from your right hand

verses.original: עַל־ הָרֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל תִּפּ֗וֹל אַתָּה֙ וְכָל־ אֲגַפֶּ֔יךָ וְעַמִּ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתָּ֑ךְ נְתַתִּ֥יךָ לְאָכְלָֽה׃ כָּל־ כָּנָ֛ף לְעֵ֨יט צִפּ֧וֹר הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה וְחַיַּ֥ת
verses.transliteration: ‘al- hā·rê yiś·rā·’êl tip·pō·wl ’at·tāh wə·ḵāl ’ă·ḡap·pe·ḵā wə·‘am·mîm ’ă·šer ’it·tāḵ nə·ṯat·tî·ḵā lə·’āḵ·lāh kāl- kā·nāp̄ lə·‘êṭ ṣip·pō·wr haś·śā·ḏeh wə·ḥay·yaṯ
verses.literal: On the mountains of Israel you will fall you and all your troops and the nations - with you I will give you as food to every kind of ravenous bird and wild beast

verses.original: תִּפּ֑וֹל עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י דִבַּ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: tip·pō·wl ‘al- pə·nê haś·śā·ḏeh kî ’ă·nî ḏib·bar·tî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: You will fall in the open field . . . for I have spoken declares the Lord GOD

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי־ אֵ֣שׁ בְּמָג֔וֹג וּבְיֹשְׁבֵ֥י לָבֶ֑טַח הָאִיִּ֖ים וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šil·laḥ·tî- ’êš bə·mā·ḡō·wḡ ū·ḇə·yō·šə·ḇê lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ hā·’î·yîm wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will send fire on Magog and on those who dwell securely in the coastlands and they will know that I am the LORD

verses.original: וְאֶת־ קָדְשִׁ֜י שֵׁ֨ם אוֹדִ֗יעַ בְּתוֹךְ֙ עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלֹֽא־ ע֑וֹד שֵׁם־ קָדְשִׁ֖י אַחֵ֥ל אֶת־ הַגּוֹיִם֙ וְיָדְע֤וּ כִּי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה קָד֖וֹשׁ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- qāḏ·šî šêm ’ō·w·ḏî·a‘ bə·ṯō·wḵ ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl wə·lō- ‘ō·wḏ šêm- qāḏ·šî ’a·ḥêl ’eṯ- hag·gō·w·yim wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh qā·ḏō·wōš bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So I will make My holy name known among My people Israel and will no longer allow it . . . to be profaned - Then the nations will know that I am the LORD the Holy One in Israel

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה בָאָה֙ וְנִֽהְיָ֔תָה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה ה֥וּא הַיּ֖וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ḇā·’āh wə·nih·yā·ṯāh nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hū hay·yō·wm ’ă·šer dib·bar·tî
verses.literal: Yes it is coming and it will surely happen declares the Lord GOD This is the day of which I have spoken

verses.original: יֹשְׁבֵ֣י׀ עָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְֽיָצְא֞וּ וּבִעֲר֡וּ וְ֠הִשִּׂיקוּ בְּנֶ֨שֶׁק וּמָגֵ֤ן וְצִנָּה֙ בְּקֶ֣שֶׁת וּבְחִצִּ֔ים וּבְמַקֵּ֥ל יָ֖ד וּבְרֹ֑מַח שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִֽים׃ וּבִעֲר֥וּ בָהֶ֛ם אֵ֖שׁ
verses.transliteration: yō·šə·ḇê ‘ā·rê yiś·rā·’êl wə·yā·ṣə·’ū ū·ḇi·‘ă·rū wə·hiś·śî·qū bə·ne·šeq ū·mā·ḡên wə·ṣin·nāh bə·qe·šeṯ ū·ḇə·ḥiṣ·ṣîm ū·ḇə·maq·qêl yāḏ ū·ḇə·rō·maḥ še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm ū·ḇi·‘ă·rū ḇā·hem ’êš
verses.literal: Then those who dwell in the cities of Israel will go out kindle fires and burn up the weapons the bucklers and shields the bows and arrows the clubs . . . and spears For seven years vvv vvv they will use them for fuel

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ יִשְׂא֨וּ עֵצִ֜ים מִן־ הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה וְלֹ֤א יַחְטְבוּ֙ מִן־ הַיְּעָרִ֔ים כִּ֥י בַנֶּ֖שֶׁק יְבַֽעֲרוּ־ אֵ֑שׁ וְשָׁלְל֣וּ אֶת־ שֹׁלְלֵיהֶ֗ם וּבָֽזְזוּ֙ אֶת־ בֹּ֣זְזֵיהֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- yiś·’ū ‘ê·ṣîm min- haś·śā·ḏeh wə·lō yaḥ·ṭə·ḇū min- hay·yə·‘ā·rîm kî ḇan·ne·šeq yə·ḇa·‘ă·rū- ’êš wə·šā·lə·lū ’eṯ- šō·lə·lê·hem ū·ḇā·zə·zū ’eṯ- bō·zə·zê·hem nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: They will not gather wood from the countryside . . . or cut it from the forests for they will use the weapons for fuel . . . They will loot - those who looted them and plunder - those who plundered them declares the Lord GOD

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה הַה֡וּא בַיּ֣וֹם אֶתֵּ֣ן לְגוֹג֩׀ קֶ֜בֶר מְקֽוֹם־ שָׁ֨ם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל גֵּ֤י הָעֹֽבְרִים֙ קִדְמַ֣ת הַיָּ֔ם הִ֖יא אֶת־ וְחֹסֶ֥מֶת הָעֹֽבְרִ֑ים גּוֹג֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הֲמוֹנֹ֔ה וְקָ֣בְרוּ שָׁ֗ם אֶת־ וְקָ֣רְא֔וּ גֵּ֖יא הֲמ֥וֹן גּֽוֹג׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ha·hū ḇay·yō·wm ’et·tên lə·ḡō·wḡ qe·ḇer mə·qō·wm- šām bə·yiś·rā·’êl gê hā·‘ō·ḇə·rîm qiḏ·maṯ hay·yām hî ’eṯ- wə·ḥō·se·meṯ hā·‘ō·ḇə·rîm gō·wḡ wə·’eṯ- kāl- hă·mō·nōh wə·qā·ḇə·rū šām ’eṯ- wə·qā·rə·’ū gê hă·mō·wn gō·wḡ
verses.literal: And on that day I will give Gog a burial place - in Israel the Valley of the Travelers east of the Sea It - will block those who travel through because Gog - and all his hordes will be buried there - So it will be called . . . vvv the Valley of Hamon-gog

verses.original: שִׁבְעָ֖ה חֳדָשִֽׁים׃ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּקְבָרוּם֙ לְמַ֖עַן טַהֵ֣ר אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ
verses.transliteration: šiḇ·‘āh ḥo·ḏā·šîm bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ū·qə·ḇā·rūm lə·ma·‘an ṭa·hêr ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: For seven months the house of Israel will be burying them in order to cleanse the land

verses.original: כָּל־ עַ֣ם הָאָ֔רֶץ וְקָֽבְרוּ֙ וְהָיָ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם לְשֵׁ֑ם י֚וֹם הִכָּ֣בְדִ֔י נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ wə·qā·ḇə·rū wə·hā·yāh lā·hem lə·šêm yō·wm hik·kā·ḇə·ḏî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: All the people of the land will bury them and it will bring them - renown on the day I display My glory declares the Lord GOD

verses.original: וְאַנְשֵׁ֨י יַבְדִּ֙ילוּ֙ תָמִ֤יד עֹבְרִ֣ים בָּאָ֔רֶץ לְטַֽהֲרָ֑הּ מְקַבְּרִ֣ים אֶת־ הָעֹבְרִ֗ים אֶת־ הַנּוֹתָרִ֛ים עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ מִקְצֵ֥ה שִׁבְעָֽה־ חֳדָשִׁ֖ים יַחְקֹֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’an·šê yaḇ·dî·lū ṯā·mîḏ ‘ō·ḇə·rîm bā·’ā·reṣ lə·ṭa·hă·rāh mə·qab·bə·rîm ’eṯ- hā·‘ō·ḇə·rîm ’eṯ- han·nō·w·ṯā·rîm ‘al- pə·nê hā·’ā·reṣ miq·ṣêh šiḇ·‘āh- ḥo·ḏā·šîm yaḥ·qō·rū
verses.literal: And men will be employed to continually pass through the land to cleanse it by burying - the invaders - who remain on vvv the ground At the end of the seven months they will begin their search

verses.original: וְעָבְר֤וּ הָעֹֽבְרִים֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ וְרָאָה֙ אָדָ֔ם עֶ֣צֶם וּבָנָ֥ה צִיּ֑וּן אֶצְל֖וֹ עַ֣ד קָבְר֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ הַֽמְקַבְּרִ֔ים אֶל־ גֵּ֖יא הֲמ֥וֹן גּֽוֹג׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·ḇə·rū hā·‘ō·ḇə·rîm bā·’ā·reṣ wə·rā·’āh ’ā·ḏām ‘e·ṣem ū·ḇā·nāh ṣî·yūn ’eṣ·lōw ‘aḏ qā·ḇə·rū ’ō·ṯōw ham·qab·bə·rîm ’el- gê hă·mō·wn gō·wḡ
verses.literal: As they pass . . . through the land anyone who sees a human bone will set up a pillar next to it until the gravediggers - have buried it in . . . vvv the Valley of Hamon-gog

verses.original: עִ֛יר וְגַ֥ם שֶׁם־ הֲמוֹנָ֖ה וְטִהֲר֥וּ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘îr wə·ḡam šem- hă·mō·w·nāh wə·ṭi·hă·rū hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Even the city will be named Hamonah And so they will cleanse the land

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֨ה בֶן־ אָדָ֜ם כֹּֽה־ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֗ה אָמַ֣ר׀ אֱמֹר֩ כָּל־ כָּנָ֜ף לְצִפּ֨וֹר וּלְכֹ֣ל׀ חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה הִקָּבְצ֤וּ וָבֹ֙אוּ֙ הֵאָסְפ֣וּ מִסָּבִ֔יב עַל־ זִבְחִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֜י זֹבֵ֤חַ לָכֶם֙ זֶ֣בַח גָּד֔וֹל עַ֖ל הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֥ם בָּשָׂ֖ר וּשְׁתִ֥יתֶם דָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ḇen- ’ā·ḏām kōh- ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar ’ĕ·mōr kāl- kā·nāp̄ lə·ṣip·pō·wr ū·lə·ḵōl ḥay·yaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh hiq·qā·ḇə·ṣū wā·ḇō·’ū hê·’ā·sə·p̄ū mis·sā·ḇîḇ ‘al- ziḇ·ḥî ’ă·šer ’ă·nî zō·ḇê·aḥ lā·ḵem ze·ḇaḥ gā·ḏō·wl ‘al hā·rê yiś·rā·’êl wa·’ă·ḵal·tem bā·śār ū·šə·ṯî·ṯem dām
verses.literal: And as for you son of man this is what the Lord GOD says Call out to every kind . . . of bird and to every beast of the field Assemble and come together from all around to the sacrificial feast that I am preparing for you . . . a great feast on the mountains of Israel There you will eat flesh and drink blood

verses.original: תֹּאכֵ֔לוּ בְּשַׂ֤ר גִּבּוֹרִים֙ תִּשְׁתּ֑וּ וְדַם־ נְשִׂיאֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ אֵילִ֨ים כָּרִ֤ים וְעַתּוּדִים֙ פָּרִ֔ים כֻּלָּֽם׃ מְרִיאֵ֥י בָשָׁ֖ן
verses.transliteration: tō·ḵê·lū bə·śar gib·bō·w·rîm tiš·tū wə·ḏam- nə·śî·’ê hā·’ā·reṣ ’ê·lîm kā·rîm wə·‘at·tū·ḏîm pā·rîm kul·lām mə·rî·’ê ḇā·šān
verses.literal: You will eat the flesh of the mighty and drink the blood of the princes of the earth [as though they were] rams lambs goats and bulls all the fattened animals of Bashan

verses.original: מִזִּבְחִ֖י אֲשֶׁר־ זָבַ֥חְתִּי לָכֶֽם׃ וַאֲכַלְתֶּם־ חֵ֣לֶב לְשָׂבְעָ֔ה וּשְׁתִ֥יתֶם דָּ֖ם לְשִׁכָּר֑וֹן
verses.transliteration: miz·ziḇ·ḥî ’ă·šer- zā·ḇaḥ·tî lā·ḵem wa·’ă·ḵal·tem- ḥê·leḇ lə·śā·ḇə·‘āh ū·šə·ṯî·ṯem dām lə·šik·kā·rō·wn
verses.literal: At the sacrifice I am preparing - you will eat fat until you are gorged and drink blood until you are drunk

verses.original: עַל־ שֻׁלְחָנִי֙ וּשְׂבַעְתֶּ֤ם ס֣וּס וָרֶ֔כֶב גִּבּ֖וֹר אִ֣ישׁ מִלְחָמָ֑ה וְכָל־ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- šul·ḥā·nî ū·śə·ḇa‘·tem sūs wā·re·ḵeḇ gib·bō·wr ’îš mil·ḥā·māh wə·ḵāl nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: And at My table you will eat your fill of horses and riders of mighty men and warriors . . . of every kind declares the Lord GOD

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֥י אֶת־ כְּבוֹדִ֖י בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם כָל־ הַגּוֹיִ֗ם אֶת־ וְרָא֣וּ מִשְׁפָּטִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתִי וְאֶת־ יָדִ֖י אֲשֶׁר־ שַׂ֥מְתִּי בָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- kə·ḇō·w·ḏî bag·gō·w·yim ḵāl hag·gō·w·yim ’eṯ- wə·rā·’ū miš·pā·ṭî ’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯî wə·’eṯ- yā·ḏî ’ă·šer- śam·tî ḇā·hem
verses.literal: I will display - My glory among the nations and all the nations - will see the judgment that I execute - and the hand that I lay upon them

verses.original: מִן־ הַה֖וּא הַיּ֥וֹם וָהָֽלְאָה׃ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְיָֽדְעוּ֙ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֑ם
verses.transliteration: min- ha·hū hay·yō·wm wā·hā·lə·’āh bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem
verses.literal: From that day forward the house of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God

verses.original: הַ֠גּוֹיִם וְיָדְע֣וּ כִּ֣י בֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל גָּל֣וּ בַעֲוֺנָ֞ם עַ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָֽעֲלוּ־ בִ֔י וָאַסְתִּ֥ר פָּנַ֖י מֵהֶ֑ם וָֽאֶתְּנֵם֙ בְּיַ֣ד צָרֵיהֶ֔ם כֻּלָּֽם׃ וַיִּפְּל֥וּ בַחֶ֖רֶב
verses.transliteration: hag·gō·w·yim wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî ḇêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl gā·lū ḇa·‘ă·wō·nām ‘al ’ă·šer mā·‘ă·lū- ḇî wā·’as·tir pā·nay mê·hem wā·’et·tə·nêm bə·yaḏ ṣā·rê·hem kul·lām way·yip·pə·lū ḇa·ḥe·reḇ
verses.literal: And the nations will know that the house of Israel went into exile for their iniquity because - they were unfaithful to Me So I hid My face from them and delivered them into the hands of their enemies so that they all fell by the sword

verses.original: עָשִׂ֣יתִי אֹתָ֑ם כְּטֻמְאָתָ֥ם וּכְפִשְׁעֵיהֶ֖ם וָאַסְתִּ֥ר פָּנַ֖י מֵהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·śî·ṯî ’ō·ṯām kə·ṭum·’ā·ṯām ū·ḵə·p̄iš·‘ê·hem wā·’as·tir pā·nay mê·hem
verses.literal: I dealt with them according to their uncleanness and transgressions and I hid My face from them

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אָמַר֙ עַתָּ֗ה אָשִׁיב֙ אֶת־ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב שְׁבִית וְרִֽחַמְתִּ֖י כָּל־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְקִנֵּאתִ֖י קָדְשִֽׁי׃ לְשֵׁ֥ם
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar ‘at·tāh ’ā·šîḇ ’eṯ- ya·‘ă·qōḇ šə·ḇīṯ wə·ri·ḥam·tî kāl- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl wə·qin·nê·ṯî qāḏ·šî lə·šêm
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says Now I will restore - Jacob from captivity and will have compassion on the whole house of Israel and I will be jealous for My holy name

verses.original: וְנָשׂוּ֙ אֶת־ כְּלִמָּתָ֔ם וְאֶת־ כָּל־ מָעֲלוּ־ מַעֲלָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִ֑י בְּשִׁבְתָּ֧ם לָבֶ֖טַח עַל־ אַדְמָתָ֛ם וְאֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·śū ’eṯ- kə·lim·mā·ṯām wə·’eṯ- kāl- mā·‘ă·lū- ma·‘ă·lām ’ă·šer ḇî bə·šiḇ·tām lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ ‘al- ’aḏ·mā·ṯām wə·’ên ma·ḥă·rîḏ
verses.literal: They will forget their disgrace and all the treachery they committed - against Me when they dwell securely in their land with no one to frighten them

verses.original: בְּשׁוֹבְבִ֤י אוֹתָם֙ מִן־ הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים וְקִבַּצְתִּ֣י אֹתָ֔ם מֵֽאַרְצ֖וֹת אֹֽיְבֵיהֶ֑ם וְנִקְדַּ֣שְׁתִּי בָ֔ם לְעֵינֵ֖י רַבִּֽים׃ הַגּוֹיִ֥ם
verses.transliteration: bə·šō·wḇ·ḇî ’ō·w·ṯām min- hā·‘am·mîm wə·qib·baṣ·tî ’ō·ṯām mê·’ar·ṣō·wṯ ’ō·yə·ḇê·hem wə·niq·daš·tî ḇām lə·‘ê·nê rab·bîm hag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: When I bring them back - from the peoples and gather them out of the lands of their enemies I will show My holiness in them in the sight of many nations

verses.original: וְיָדְע֗וּ כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם וְכִנַּסְתִּ֖ים עַל־ אַדְמָתָ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ ע֛וֹד מֵהֶ֖ם שָֽׁם׃ אוֹתִ֥יר בְּהַגְלוֹתִ֤י אֹתָם֙ אֶל־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem wə·ḵin·nas·tîm ‘al- ’aḏ·mā·ṯām wə·lō- ‘ō·wḏ mê·hem šām ’ō·w·ṯîr bə·haḡ·lō·w·ṯî ’ō·ṯām ’el- hag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: Then they will know that I am the LORD their God when I regather them to their own land not leaving any of them . . . behind after their exile . . . among the nations

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ ע֛וֹד אַסְתִּ֥יר פָּנַ֖י מֵהֶ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁפַ֤כְתִּי אֶת־ רוּחִי֙ עַל־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ‘ō·wḏ ’as·tîr pā·nay mê·hem ’ă·šer šā·p̄aḵ·tî ’eṯ- rū·ḥî ‘al- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: And I will no longer hide My face from them for I will pour out - My Spirit on the house of Israel declares the Lord GOD
